title: Eppendorf 5424R refrigerated microcentrifuge
manualMd: Refrigerated 24-position microcentrifuge for 1.5 mL / 2 mL tubes. Max RCF 21,130 × g. Holds 4 °C reliably during 30-min spins; pre-cool the rotor before time-sensitive work.
hazardsMd:
- Always balance tubes by mass, not eye. An unbalanced rotor can fail catastrophically at full speed.
- Wait for the rotor to fully stop before opening the lid.
- Inspect the rotor monthly for hairline cracks; pull from service if found.

operations.title: Daily startup check
operations.bodyMd:
1. Wipe rotor + chamber with 70% ethanol.
2. Confirm the rotor seats fully and the lid latches.
3. Set the temperature; let the chamber pre-cool for 5 min before loading tubes.

operations.title: Balance the load
operations.bodyMd: Place tubes opposite each other (12-o'clock + 6-o'clock pattern). When odd-numbered, fill a balance tube with water of the same mass.

operations.title: Bearing whine
operations.bodyMd: Stop immediately. Do NOT continue spinning. Tag out and contact the lab manager. Symptoms of imminent rotor or motor failure include grinding, chirping, or vibration outside normal.

operations.title: Will not reach set temperature
operations.bodyMd: Check that the chamber is dry (condensation can pool and form ice). Open the lid for 10 min, dry with a soft cloth, then re-run the cool-down. If the issue persists, the compressor may need service.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd:
1. Remove all tubes.
2. Wipe the rotor and chamber dry.
3. Leave the lid OPEN to prevent condensation buildup.
4. Log the use if your lab requires it.
